name: ak47
stats_provenance: CS:S AK-47 as documented publicly: 600 rounds/min, 30-round magazine, 90 spare; about 36 body damage vs the M4's 33 and Halo's assault rifle's lighter rounds. Damage and spread are expressed relative to the base Halo weapon.
view_model_mirrored_provenance: CS:S view models are authored left-handed; the game mirrors them with cl_righthand 1 (its default).
crosshair_and_reload_provenance: CS:S AK-47 reload: 2.5 s (published). Crosshair: CS:S draws arms with a gap; the dot and the sizes are ours.
